en: to be improved; to be reformed

examples.en: My health improved after I took the medicine.
The service is getting better little by little.
If the environment improves, more people gather.
I can see the parts that are improving.
This problem needs to be improved quickly.
I hope the mood in the room gets much better.

explain: 나쁜 부분이 좋아질 때 써요. 상태, 제도, 서비스처럼 고칠 수 있는 것에 어울려요. 날씨나 기분이 좋아질 때는 '좋아지다'를 써요.
explain_en: Use it when a weak part gets better. It fits things you can fix, such as conditions, systems, or services. For weather or mood, say '좋아지다'.

examples.ko: 이 도시는 최근 몇 년 사이 급성장했어요.
examples.en: This city has grown rapidly in the past few years.
The delivery market is growing rapidly.
A rapidly growing company hires many employees.

examples.ko: 이 가게는 입소문 덕분에 급성장할 거예요.
examples.en: Thanks to word of mouth, this shop will grow fast.

examples.ko: 관광객이 늘면서 이 지역이 급성장해서 집값이 올랐어요.
examples.en: As tourists increased, this area grew rapidly and housing prices rose.

examples.ko: 급성장한 만큼 해결할 문제도 많이 생겼어요.
examples.en: Because it grew so fast, many problems to solve have come up.

explain: '급성장하다'는 '빠르게 성장하다'를 한 단어로 줄인 느낌이고, 시장, 기업, 지역처럼 사람이 아닌 대상에 많이 써요. 사람이 빨리 자랄 때는 '쑥쑥 자라다' 같은 쉬운 표현이 어울려요. 명사 '급성장'에 '하다'가 붙은 말이라 '급성장을 하다'로도 써요.
explain_en: 급성장하다 is like a one-word shortening of 빠르게 성장하다, and it is mostly used for non-person subjects such as markets, companies and regions. When a person grows quickly, an easier expression like 쑥쑥 자라다 fits better. It is the noun 급성장 plus 하다, so 급성장을 하다 is also possible.

en: to nurture; to bring up; to take care of

examples.ko: 이 어린이집은 아이를 하루 종일 보육해요.
examples.en: This daycare cares for children all day.

examples.ko: 맞벌이 부부를 위해 회사가 직원 자녀를 보육해 줘요.
examples.en: The company looks after employees' children for dual-income couples.
The government helps with the cost of caring for children.

examples.ko: 저는 아기를 보육하는 선생님이 되고 싶어요.
examples.en: I want to become a teacher who takes care of babies.

examples.ko: 새 센터에서 아기를 보육할 선생님을 구하고 있어요.
examples.en: The new center is looking for teachers to care for babies.

examples.ko: 어릴 때 아이를 잘 보육하면 건강하게 자라요.
examples.en: If you care for a child well when young, they grow up healthy.

explain: 어린아이를 돌보고 키울 때 쓰는 공식적인 말이에요. 집에서 부모가 아기를 키울 때는 '키우다', '돌보다'를 더 많이 말해요. '보육'은 어린이집과 나라 정책 이야기에서 주로 나와요.
explain_en: A formal word for looking after and raising small children. At home, parents say '키우다' or '돌보다'. '보육' mainly appears with daycares and government policy.

en: to found; to establish (a school, company, organization)

examples.en: I will establish a company next year.

examples.ko: 이 학교는 백 년 전에 한 선교사가 설립했어요.
examples.en: A missionary founded this school a hundred years ago.

examples.ko: 친구와 같이 작은 출판사를 설립하고 싶어요.
examples.en: I want to found a small publishing company with a friend.
The person who set up the foundation was a teacher.
There is a plan to establish a new library.
You need documents to establish an organization.

explain: 회사, 학교, 단체처럼 공식적인 조직을 새로 세울 때 써요. 집이나 건물은 '짓다'를 쓰고, 가게를 여는 것은 '차리다'나 '열다'를 더 자주 말해요.
explain_en: It is used when you newly set up an official organization such as a company, school or group. For houses and buildings use '짓다', and for opening a shop '차리다' or '열다' is more common.

examples.en: The village patrol goes around the alleys every night.
Crime has dropped thanks to the patrol team.
A parent patrol watches over the route to school.

examples.ko: 순찰대는 이상한 사람을 보면 바로 신고해요.
examples.en: The patrol reports right away if they see a suspicious person.
The beach patrol keeps an eye on the swimmers.
A volunteer patrol was formed in our neighborhood too.

explain: '순찰대'는 경찰이 아니어도 동네 사람들이 자원해서 만들 수 있어요. 경찰이 타고 다니는 차는 '순찰차', 돌아다니며 살피는 일은 '순찰하다'라고 해요. 이 세 단어를 같이 기억해 두면 편해요.
explain_en: A 순찰대 does not have to be police; neighbors can form one as volunteers. The car police patrol in is a 순찰차, and the act of going around and watching is 순찰하다. It helps to remember these three words together.

examples.en: The two companies made the film as a joint venture.
It is a joint Korea-Japan drama.
This album is a collaboration between two singers.
They decided to set up a joint company.
This painting is a work the brothers made together.
We are looking into a joint investment.

explain: 나라나 회사가 함께 만들 때 '합작 영화', '합작 회사'처럼 앞에 붙여요. '협력'은 서로 돕는 것 전체이고, '합작'은 함께 만든 결과물이나 사업에 주로 써요.
explain_en: When countries or companies make something together, it attaches in front, as in '합작 영화' (joint film) and '합작 회사' (joint company). '협력' (cooperation) covers any kind of helping each other, while '합작' is mostly for a jointly made product or business.
